definitions.absolute_error_reduction: no-referral error rate minus automatic error rate; probability-point difference; replicate-specific reference
definitions.aurc: right-endpoint step integral over coverage; sum(delta_coverage * retained_error_rate); empty curve undefined
definitions.automatic_error: non-referred incorrect / non-referred predictions; undefined with zero automatic predictions
definitions.bootstrap: paired whole-image resampling with replacement; fixed original development thresholds; no threshold rederivation; percentile CIs; no redraw
definitions.crop_risk: maximum retained prediction risk; empty crop is undefined and never referred
definitions.curve: retain ascending risk with entire equal-score groups; coverage=retained/total predictions; risk=retained incorrect/retained
definitions.error_capture: incorrect predictions in referred crops / all incorrect predictions; undefined without errors
definitions.paired_difference: weighted TrustPCB minus reference on the same replicate; negative favours weighted for AURC/automatic error, positive for capture
definitions.random: uniform selection without replacement among nonempty crops at achieved workload; analytic expected capture=k/nonempty crops
definitions.scope: final evaluation of frozen development thresholds on 2052 test crops
definitions.target: incorrect_prediction = 1 - correct_iou50; existing same-class one-to-one IoU >= 0.50
definitions.threshold: load exact saved development values; never derive from test data

test_role: held out from RQ2 training and development, previously used for RQ1 validation.
